Satellite name CaNOP (Canopy Near-IR Observing Project)
Spacecraft type CubeSat
Units or mass 3U
Status not launched, expected in 2026
Launcher Falcon 9, (ELaNa 36)
Organisation Carthage College
Institution University
Entity Academic / Education
Headquarters US
Oneliner

Replicate early Landsat remote sensing capabilities.

Description

Remote sensing platform for performing multispectral imaging of global forests to help understand large-scale biomass production and carbon uptake in both mature and harvested forests.
